text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer chained sentences with multiple clauses","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"Uses more extended sentence structures with subordinating and coordinating ideas, showing greater control of complex expression."},{"evidence":"clear intro body conclusion transitions like \"Also,\" \"In addition,\" and \"Overall,\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"Presents ideas in a more clearly sequenced, paragraph-like progression with recognizable transitions between points."},{"evidence":"direct thesis statement and repeated claim support","quality":"argument development","description":"States a central claim and revisits it with supporting reasons and examples more consistently than the other essay."},{"evidence":"specific personal narrative about arriving in the United States in 2017","quality":"relevant elaboration","description":"Adds concrete, connected details that expand and support the main idea rather than staying at a single general point."},{"evidence":"uses academic connectors such as \"because,\" \"unless,\" \"so that,\" and \"therefore\"-style linking","quality":"cohesive devices","description":"Relies more effectively on linking words to connect causes, results, and conditions across sentences."},{"evidence":"more sustained essay format across multiple paragraphs","quality":"textual coherence","description":"Maintains a more unified line of thought over the whole response instead of shifting as abruptly or repeating the same claim in a looser way."}]}
